infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Workshop uses your location for the Location and Commute apps.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Workshop tracks your location in the background to power commute alerts and the location history, replacing OwnTracks.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Workshop records audio for the Birds app.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Workshop tracks your location in the background to power commute alerts and location history.

plugins.microphonePermission: Workshop records audio for the Birds app.

extra.comment: webUrl = the Workshop SPA the WebView loads (Tailscale Serve :8443 -> vite, which proxies /api to the backend so the cookie login is same-origin). apiBase = the backend for native producer posts (Tailscale Serve :8446 -> :8000; no /api suffix, the backend accepts both). Auth: the WebView logs in via cookie, then provisions a device token the native producers send as a Bearer. tier flips to 'paid' after Apple Developer Program enrolment. These require the iPhone on the operator's tailnet (Tailscale app).
